preservation.priorQualificationMeaning: Exact historical qualification-results.json SHA preserved; baseline receipt records 4033 PASS. It remains historical, not the final campaign test count.

newProviderEvidence.boundary: No positive actual-live/new-provider counter found in scanned mission JSON/JSONL; frozen live records and guard hashes unchanged. Synthetic request URLs, model labels, usage and replayed historical payloads are not proof of new network execution. This is an artifact audit, not an independent network packet capture.

commitRecommendation.policy: Use an explicit path whitelist. Do not stage the entire worktree, the whole validation directory, ignored provider evidence, or raw runtime dumps. Preserve local raw proofs and cite their hashes from committed receipts.

appendWhenFinalized: Exact final report path once root creates it; not guessed or staged by this audit

reproducibleOfflineCampaignInputsAndTool.note: Frozen source corpus (~3 MiB) is an input, not a runtime dump. Include this explicit package if replay reproducibility is required. Historical recorded-live fixtures remain local protected dependencies; do not copy them into the commit.

keepLocal.note: The typed historical red probe remains an intentionally failing reproduction. Keep its original copy and receipt, or explicitly exclude it from green test discovery; never add a broad campaign test glob to final gates.

limitations: Browser qualification was still adding new local artifacts during capture; volumes/provider counters are a timestamped snapshot. Existing baseline files and 16 product sources were stable individually during hashing.
No credential or .env contents were read. Path-based exclusions and regular-file checks precede hashing.
Index byte-for-byte preservation cannot be inferred from an absent baseline index hash; no staged change and unchanged HEAD establish the required semantic preservation.
This audit neither replays tests nor changes product, corpus or historical evidence.
